{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Infobox NPC |version1 = Before quest |version2 = After quest |name = Gertrude |image = [[File:Gertrude.png|110px]] |release1 = [[28 July]] [[2003]] |release2 = [[3 August]] [[2017]] |update1 = New Members Quest Online |update2 = Inferno slayer task, Tournament worlds, and Poll 56! |members = No |race = [[Human]] |quest = [[Gertrude's Cat]], [[A Tail of Two Cats]], [[Ratcatchers]], [[A Ruff Situation]] |location = [[Varrock]] |gender = Female |options1 = Talk-to |options2 = Talk-to, Kitten |examine = A busy housewife. |map = {{Map|name=Gertrude|3151,3409|mtype=square|r=3}} |id1 = 7284 |id2 = 7723 |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} [[File:Gertrude chathead.png|left]] '''Gertrude Fairweather'''{{CiteText|text=Varrock Census|quote=[Citizen's name] Gertrude Fairweather.|loc=}} is a woman living in a house just west of [[Varrock]]. She is the starting point for both the [[Gertrude's Cat]] and [[Ratcatchers]] [[quests]]. She has four sons: [[Wilough]], [[Shilop]], [[Philop]], and [[Kanel]]. Her husband, [[Walter Fairweather]], is a travelling merchant, and is not present ingame. Once your cat has become [[Overgrown cat|overgrown]], she will sell you [[cat|kittens]] for {{Coins|100}}, but keep in mind you can only have one kitten at a time. When you have a normal cat in your inventory or in your bank, she won't give you a kitten. '''If you store your normal cats in your POH, she will sell you a new kitten.''' The colour of the kitten is random unless you have a [[Ring of Charos(a)]], then you will be able to charm Gertrude into letting you choose the colour of the kitten. Doing so the first time completes a [[medium Varrock Diary]] task. Once a player catches 100 [[rat]]s with their cat, she'll award them with the [[cat training medal]]. Note that this must be done before their cat reaches overgrown stage, or they'll not get the reward. ==Treasure Trails== *{{Anagram|Gertrude|beginner|[[Clue scroll (beginner) - RUG DETER|RUG DETER]]}}. ==Dialogue== {{Hastranscript|npc}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 3 August 2017 |update = Inferno slayer task, Tournament worlds, and Poll 56! |change = A right-click option to Quick buy kittens from Gertrude has been added. }} {{Subject changes |date = 29 May 2007 |update = Varrock's New Look |change = The NPC was graphically updated with the rework of Varrock. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 September 2005 |update = A Tail of Two Cats |change = The NPC now always appears above players standing in the same tile. }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 June 2005 |update = Rogues Den + Tweaks |change = The NPC's appearance was altered again with the second rework of female bodykits. }} {{Subject changes |date = 31 May 2005 |update = New Female Bodykit |change = The NPC's appearance was altered with the rework of female bodykits. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Gertrude (historical v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Gertrude (historical v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Gertrude (historical v3).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Gertrude.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Gertrude chathead (historical).png]] |[[File:Gertrude chathead (historical).png]] |[[File:Gertrude chathead (historical).png]] |[[File:Gertrude chathead.png]] |- |29 March 2004 –
